mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_document ( tenant_id, document_no, approval_code, business_type, business_id, title, body, requester_user_id, requester_department_id, supervising_department_id, status, current_step_order, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{documentNo}, #{approvalCode}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{requesterUserId}, #{requesterDepartmentId}, #{supervisingDepartmentId}, 'IN_PROGRESS', 1, NOW() )

INSERT INTO approval_document_step ( document_id, step_order, step_name, approval_type, target_department_type, target_department_id, target_role_key, target_user_id, group_approval_yn, status ) VALUES ( #{documentId}, #{s.stepOrder}, #{s.stepName}, COALESCE(#{s.approvalType}, 'APPROVE'), #{s.targetDepartmentType}, #{s.targetDepartmentId}, #{s.targetRoleKey}, #{s.targetUserId}, COALESCE(#{s.groupApprovalYn}, TRUE), 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.step_id, s.step_order, s.step_name, s.approval_type, s.target_department_type, s.target_department_id, o.name AS target_department_name, s.target_role_key, s.target_user_id, tu.name AS target_user_name, s.group_approval_yn, s.status, s.acted_by_user_id, u.name AS acted_by_name, s.acted_at, s.comment FROM approval_document_step s LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.org_id = s.target_department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.acted_by_user_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = s.target_user_id WHERE s.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY s.step_order

SELECT s.step_id, s.step_order, s.step_name, s.approval_type, s.target_department_type, s.target_department_id, o.name AS target_department_name, s.target_role_key, s.target_user_id, tu.name AS target_user_name, s.group_approval_yn, s.status, s.acted_by_user_id, u.name AS acted_by_name, s.acted_at, s.comment FROM approval_document_step s LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.org_id = s.target_department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.acted_by_user_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = s.target_user_id WHERE s.document_id = #{documentId} AND s.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY s.step_order LIMIT 1

SELECT h.history_id, h.step_id, h.action_type, h.action_by, u.name AS action_by_name, h.action_comment, h.action_at, h.before_status, h.after_status FROM approval_history h LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = h.action_by WHERE h.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY h.action_at, h.history_id

SELECT d.document_id, d.tenant_id, d.document_no, d.approval_code, def.approval_name, d.business_type, d.business_id, d.title, d.body, d.requester_user_id, u.name AS requester_name, d.requester_department_id, ro.name AS requester_department_name, d.supervising_department_id, so.name AS supervising_department_name, d.status, d.current_step_order, d.requested_at, d.completed_at FROM approval_document d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = d.requester_user_id LEFT JOIN orgs ro ON ro.org_id = d.requester_department_id LEFT JOIN orgs so ON so.org_id = d.supervising_department_id LEFT JOIN approval_definition def ON def.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND def.approval_code = d.approval_code WHERE d.document_id = #{documentId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_document SET status = #{status}, current_step_order = #{currentStepOrder}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.document_id, d.tenant_id, d.document_no, d.approval_code, def.approval_name, d.title, d.requester_user_id, u.name AS requester_name, d.requester_department_id, ro.name AS requester_department_name, d.supervising_department_id, so.name AS supervising_department_name, d.status, d.current_step_order, (SELECT cs.step_name FROM approval_document_step cs WHERE cs.document_id = d.document_id AND cs.step_order = d.current_step_order LIMIT 1) AS current_step_name, d.requested_at, d.completed_at FROM approval_document d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = d.requester_user_id LEFT JOIN orgs ro ON ro.org_id = d.requester_department_id LEFT JOIN orgs so ON so.org_id = d.supervising_department_id LEFT JOIN approval_definition def ON def.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND def.approval_code = d.approval_code WHERE ORDER BY d.requested_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.document_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
